Subject: Q3 mid-cycle: deal triage — R/Y/G escalation and seller save-plan checklist

Team,

Quick mid-cycle ask: I ran a pull of our Q3 committed/forecasted deals and carved a preliminary R/Y/G list for triage. Please do the following by EOD Friday (7/3):

1) Open the attached save_plan_template.xlsx and populate the row for any deal you own with: current stage, main blocker, next milestone, probability (SFDC), and 2‑point save-plan (owner + 72h action).
2) Flag any deal that should be bumped to the formal Red Escalation (procurement/legal blockers or exec sign required). Use the redlist snapshot column.
3) Update the HubSpot deal record (link below) with the new expected close and attach the filled template.

For Acme (RWI-2026-ACME-37) specifically: Neha — you flagged procurement timing last week; please confirm whether the procurement team provided the new templated SOW or if we need to re-engage legal. If red, mark the escalation checkbox and I will loop in CS and Finance for contingency credits.

I want a short summary (1–2 bullets) in reply to this thread when you’re done. We’ll run a 15‑minute stand at 9:30am PT on Monday (7/6) to review red items only.

Attachments: save_plan_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RWI-ACME-37

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus —

Quick status on Acme (RWI-2026-ACME-37): moved to RED.

Reason: Procurement pushed back on our standard data residency clause and requested a written audit trail showing hash-only logging — their procurement lead (ProcureOps) says legal needs a specific attestation before signing. They sent an SOW template this morning with redlines; I attached the key excerpt to the HubSpot timeline.

Immediate asks:
- Can Legal provide the attestation language or an alternative we can offer this week?
- If not, I need Exec cover to prioritize a one‑way data retention exception (short-term).

Save-plan (short):
- Neha (owner): Request legal attestation by 7/3 EOD; if not available, propose scoped exception + credit construct to Procurement on 7/5.
- Next milestone: Procurement approval window opens 7/8.

External contacts: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@acmeinc.com>, ProcureOps <procure@acmeinc.com>.

I’ve updated the save_plan_template row and attached redlist_snapshot.png to the internal Drive folder.

—Neha
